description: This file defines the JsonDynamicArray class, a custom dynamic array wrapper around JsonArray with dynamic member access, indexers, and conversion operators, used for flexible JSON manipulation within the OrchardCore project.

classes.name: JsonDynamicArray
classes.description: A dynamic wrapper around JsonArray enabling index-based, member, and method invocation access, with internal caching and implicit conversions.

methods.name: GetValue
methods.description: Retrieves the value at a specified index, wrapping JsonObject, JsonArray, or JsonValue into corresponding dynamic types.

methods.name: SetValue
methods.description: Sets the value at a specified index, converting objects to JsonNode types as needed.

methods.name: Remove
methods.description: Removes a specified JsonNode item from the array.

methods.name: RemoveAt
methods.description: Removes the item at the specified index.

methods.name: TryGetIndex
methods.description: Attempts to get a value by index using dynamic get index binder.

methods.name: TrySetIndex
methods.description: Attempts to set a value by index using dynamic set index binder.

methods.name: TryInvokeMember
methods.description: Invokes a method on the underlying JsonArray via reflection.

methods.name: GetEnumerator
methods.description: Returns an enumerator over the dynamic array's values.

methods.name: TryGetMember
methods.description: Provides dynamic member access, mainly for debugging.

methods.name: GetDynamicMemberNames
methods.description: Returns dynamic member names for debugging.
